title: Admin reviews a pending event fee
description: Find a pending event fee in Payment Log, open the member’s plan ledger, then continue to Clear in the cash-payment walkthrough.

steps.title: Admin home
steps.body: When a member pays cash for an event at the desk, a Pending row appears in Payment Log until an admin Clears it.

steps.title: Open Payment Log
steps.body: Open Payment Log to see pending event fees alongside plan purchases.

steps.title: Find the member
steps.body: Filter by Finley Ortiz to focus on their pending event fee for Tutorial Event Night.

steps.title: Pending event fee
steps.body: The purpose line shows Event registration for Tutorial Event Night. Status stays Pending with Clear / Reject until the desk confirms cash.
steps.resultNote: Event fee is cash Pending — not a plan purchase.

steps.title: Open member ledger
steps.body: Click the member name to open their plan / payment ledger without leaving Payments.

steps.title: Member plan ledger
steps.body: The overlay shows the member’s plan status and payment history. Close it when you are ready to Clear the pending event fee in Payment Log.
steps.resultNote: Ledger opened from the Payment Log name link.

steps.title: Next: clear the cash
steps.body: Clearing this pending event fee is the same Clear action as plan cash. Continue with “Admin clears a cash payment” for that step.
